messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: P1 detected — increased SSE disconnects for streaming/function-calling routes (region: us-east-1). Auto-page to on-call. Root: 1769934567
Alex Chen: seeing reconnect storms and parse errors in the function-call handler. Clients report early close and 502s from our edge. Trying to collect a sample trace.
Maria Ortiz: confirmed multiple customers on Dedicated and Hosted experiencing truncated toolcall payloads. Severity: degradation for streaming sessions.
Sanjay Rao: copying logs from stream-proxy (trimmed):
```
2026-03-15T16:09:12Z ERROR stream-proxy connection.go:214 parse toolcall payload: unexpected token at pos 128
2026-03-15T16:09:12Z WARN stream-proxy connection.go:267 client disconnected (SSE close) id=xyz-123
2026-03-15T16:09:13Z INFO router router.go:112 fallback-to-sync model=redwood-small client=abc-42
```
Alex Chen: hypothesis 1 — recent parsing tweak in function-caller service (v1.3.2) rejects certain Content-Type or chunked bodies, causing proxy to close connection. Hypothesis 2 — a client-interop change (library v2.0) sends a trailing control byte that our parser treats as malformed.\noncall-bot: @channel on-call switch: initial responder = Alex Chen (active), handoff scheduled at +30m if unresolved.
Lee Kim: I can pull tcpdump from edge for the failed session ids. Which ids? Alex can paste the session ids.
Alex Chen: session ids: xyz-123, xyz-150, xyz-188. Also saw pattern: larger toolcall payloads >8KB more likely to fail.
Jess Patel: I ran a quick curl to reproduce:
```
curl -v -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @payload.json \
  https://stream.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=foo
```
payload.json contains a nested JSON with a `tool_call` object and a final newline. On my run the connection closed after first 2 tokens in the SSE stream.
Maria Ortiz: mitigation idea: temporarily disable the new parser path via config flag `FF_TOOLCALL_STRICT=false` in canary region and see if errors drop. Also fallback route to stateless sync endpoint for new sessions.
Sanjay Rao: toggled `FF_TOOLCALL_STRICT=false` on edge-canary at 16:20 UTC. Monitoring...
Alex Chen: after toggle — error rate for the canary pool dropped from 22% -> 3% within 90s. Looks like parser strictness is the trigger.
Jess Patel: note: customers using client-lib v2.0 still see higher disconnects when payloads have trailing commas in arrays. That lines up with stricter JSON parsing rejecting otherwise-tolerated patterns.
Lee Kim: collecting full tcpdump + connection logs and will upload to incident channel artifact storage (link forthcoming).
Maria Ortiz: action items while we remain live: 1) roll FF_TOOLCALL_STRICT=false to us-east-1 primary (Sanjay), 2) create compatibility alert for clients sending non-standard JSON (Alex), 3) schedule regression test coverage for streaming/curl/edge combos (Jess), 4) customer comms draft (Maria).
oncall-bot: handoff note: after 30m handoff to Maria Ortiz unless Alex requests extension.
Sanjay Rao: rolling flag to us-east-1 now. Command used: `envctl set feature FF_TOOLCALL_STRICT false --env prod --region us-east-1` (dry-run validated).
Alex Chen: confirm: after global flag flip and increased monitoring, error rates normalized to baseline. Root cause confirmed as overly strict parser introduced in function-caller service 1.3.2 that did not accept some legacy client payloads (trailing commas, unquoted control characters).
Jess Patel: RCA hypothesis refined: parser change was intended to make tool-call validation stricter, but missed a migration toggle (we thought default would be permissive). Change was merged without a dedicated interoperability test for SSE streaming clients.
Maria Ortiz: customer impact: affected ~8 Hosted workspaces and 3 Dedicated customers intermittently between 16:08–16:32 UTC; main symptom: truncated SSE streams and early disconnects. No data loss beyond stream truncation; many clients automatically retried.
Alex Chen: long-term mitigations proposed in-thread: - revert strict parsing as default and gate behind opt-in; - add streaming interop test matrix (curl, node client v1/v2, python client); - add synthetic canary with fuzzed trailing bytes; - docs update and cherrypick to 1.3.3 with compatibility mode.
Sanjay Rao: filed infra ticket INF-2337 for the feature flag rollout automation + rollback playbook.
Jess Patel: I'll own the test matrix PR and the regression tests.
Maria Ortiz: I'll draft customer comms (status + root cause + fix ETA). Alex — please attach the sample malformed payload and minimal repro to the RCA ticket.
Alex Chen: attaching sample in ticket RCA-456. Also adding timeline: 16:08 first spike, 16:12 incident page, 16:20 flag toggled in canary, 16:23 drop in canary errors, 16:28 global flag roll, 16:32 errors resolved.
oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident state changed to mitigated. Please follow up with postmortem in 24h and ensure RFC for parser gating is submitted.
Maria Ortiz: will schedule postmortem doc and link to this thread. Thanks all for quick responses. :heart:
